description:
Fidelity reviewer called out these specific gaps:

1. PartialJson: parse_streaming with escaped quote inside unterminated string (real tool-call scenario):
   assert parse_streaming(~s({\"regex\": \"a\\\\\"b)) == %{\"regex\" => \"a\\\"b\"}

2. Decoder: text block followed by tool_use in one stream (Claude's \"Let me look... <tool_use>\" pattern).

3. Decoder: out-of-order content_block_start indices (index:1 before index:0). We handle it via the index_map but it's not tested.

4. SSE+Producer: UTF-8 multi-byte char sliced across two HTTP chunks inside a text_delta (currently only tested at the SSE layer).

5. Request: parameterized tool-call ID sanitization — empty string, all-invalid chars, pathological-that-becomes-empty, OpenAI-style pipe ID, Google-style dot ID.

6. Producer: caller-dies-mid-stream test (ties to opi-hgb.2 — once :aborted exists, test it).

7. Regression test for the \"partialJson not persisted on final tool-call\" invariant (structurally enforced by our design but worth pinning).

TDD: these are \"add test, verify it passes (or catches a bug)\" — pure test additions. If any fail on current code, open a separate ticket for the fix.

Depends on opi-hgb.2 for #6 (need :aborted to test for it).

Files: partial_json_test.exs, decoder_test.exs, producer_test.exs, request_test.exs, ai_stream_test.exs (moved; it's anthropic_stream_test.exs now? wait, it's ai_stream_test.exs in the anthropic app).
title: Add missing test coverage per fidelity review
